text:
```yaml
name: Release Binaries

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  compile-and-upload:
    name: Compile and upload ${{ matrix.target }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        target:
          - x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          - x86_64-apple-darwin
          - aarch64-apple-darwin
          - x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Deno
        uses: denoland/setup-deno@v3
        with:
          deno-version: v1.x

      - name: Install GitHub CLI
        uses: cli/cli@v2

      - name: Compile binary
        run: |
          TARGET=${{ matrix.target }}
          OUTPUT="invidious-companion-${TARGET}"
          case "$TARGET" in
            x86_64-pc-windows-msvc) OUTPUT+=".exe" ;;
            *) ;;
          esac
          deno compile --target "$TARGET" --output "$OUTPUT" src/index.ts
          echo "OUTPUT=$OUTPUT" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        env:
          DENO_INSTALL_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}

      - name: Upload asset to release
        run: |
          gh release upload "${{ github.ref_name }}" "$OUTPUT" --clobber
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
